title: Feature 019 additive workflow IR fragment (draft, not canonical)
description: Additions to specs/001-platform-foundation/contracts/workflow.schema.json under ADR-0032. apiVersion stays sagat-octopus-orchestrator.io/v1. Each field is optional; publication refuses a field whose capability the server does not enable (VALIDATION_FAILED, details.reason UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY). Merge target per $defs entry is named in its description.

priority.description: Dispatch priority: 1 is the highest, 3 the default. Strict within the candidates one worker session may take.

versioningBehavior.description: How a step whose activity belongs to a worker deployment is routed: pinned uses the run's pin for that deployment (created at the first claim); autoUpgrade uses the routing in force at each claim.

workflowDispatch.description: Merge as root property `dispatch`. Defaults for runs of this workflow version; start options override them.

fairnessKey.description: Tagged so that a value such as input.customerId is never ambiguous: {"literal": key} with key matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,64}$, or {"expr": expression} over `input` only, evaluated once at admission with the existing bounded evaluator; a result outside the key pattern refuses admission (VALIDATION_FAILED, DISPATCH_EXPRESSION). An {expr} key is classified with the ADR-0033 level of the input field it reads (pii when undeclared); publication refuses one above internal (DISPATCH_KEY_LEVEL) or one that reads a location encoded under feature 031 (the encoded-location check of FR-031-006, code ENCODING_READ_BY_FAIRNESS_KEY, registry specs/031-client-side-encryption/contracts/encoded-field-registry.md).

nodeDispatch.description: Merge as property `dispatch` of activity and script nodes (script nodes accept only priority: scripts are outside deployments) and of their body variants.

childDispatch.description: Merge as property `dispatch` of child nodes. Absent fields inherit the parent's run values; `deployment: current` starts the child without inherited pins.

asyncCompletion.description: Merge as property `asyncCompletion` of activity nodes (and bodyActivity). Allows a worker or a push function to detach the attempt and complete it through REST with a task token. Both durations are clamped by the step timeout and the run deadline; above the ceilings the definition is refused.

heartbeatSchema.description: Merge as property `heartbeatSchema` of activity and script nodes. A JSON Schema for checkpoint details, carrying the ADR-0033 classification annotation like outputSchema. Undeclared fields are pii. It does not validate a checkpoint against business rules; it classifies it for disclosure. Encoding follows 031's encoded-field registry (specs/031-client-side-encryption/contracts/encoded-field-registry.md): on activity it is a 031 carrier (kinds K, S: checkpoint and final failure details are a write path); on script declaring x-sagat-encoding is refused (ENCODING_NOT_PRODUCIBLE); a checkpoint of an attempt with a non-empty payload plan and no encoded heartbeatSchema is refused with ENCODING_REQUIRED while the lease renewal still commits.

continueAsNewDeployment.description: Merge as property `deployment` of continueAsNew. inherit copies the segment's pins and dispatch options to the successor in the handoff transaction; current copies dispatch options but no pins. The workflow version is unchanged (FR-014-012).
